default_compliance_profile.description: Default VeilAI compliance routing profile: GDPR_EU | HIPAA_MEDICAL | DEVSECOPS_CODE | FINANCIAL_TAX

cloud_audit_model.description: Primary Cloud Gemini model used via Firebase AI Logic ONLY_IN_CLOUD / PREFER_IN_CLOUD for deep expert audits on strictly scrubbed payloads (high free-tier quota, no billing required; cascades automatically).

cloud_fast_fallback_model.description: Fast cloud fallback model used for PREFER_ON_DEVICE triage & rewrites when on-device Gemini Nano 4 is unavailable.

strict_local_firewall.description: When true, Stage 1 PII/Secret redaction strictly uses InferenceMode.ONLY_ON_DEVICE + deterministic local regex vault and never falls back to cloud with raw PII.

cloud_escalation_mode.description: InferenceMode for Stage 2 deep audit: ONLY_IN_CLOUD or PREFER_IN_CLOUD (falls back to on-device if offline).

compliance_profiles_json.description: JSON map of live enterprise redaction policies controlled remotely via Firebase Remote Config.
